article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com community event notice announcing a recurring 'House Party Tuesday' in which players meet in Sanctuary and visit decorated player homes, with a special 'House Party' character teleporting to featured houses. The first listed session was Tuesday April 6, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time on Server 1. The post date is not stated exactly (only a relative 'posted 2 weeks, 2 days ago').

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?

A special Community Team character named 'House Party' teleports to featured houses and can be added to the Friends List; players can teleport to him when he moves. The article gives no post date beyond a relative 'posted 2 weeks, 6 days ago'.

article_summaries.title: Community Event: House Party on Sunday!
article_summaries.summary: A Community Team event announcement (page titled in Spanish, body in English) for a House Party on Sunday, September 18, 2011, at 3pm Pacific Time on Server 1. Players were to meet in Sanctuary and tour decorated player houses, guided by a community character named House Party who teleports to featured houses. The article date is inferred from the event date; the posting date is not shown.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A SOE community news post announcing a special Wilds Condo Tuesday edition of the weekly House Party community event on Tuesday, January 31, 2012, in Sanctuary on Server 1. Players were invited to show off their newly assigned Wilds Condo, and the Community Team's House Party character would move between homes for teleporting.
